inlines.v: SECU'RELY, adv. 1. Without danger; safely; as, to pass a river on ice securely. But safely is generally used. 2. Without fear or apprehension; carelessly; in an unguarded state; in confidence of safety. His daring foe securely him defied. Milton. Devise not evil against thy neighbor, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee. Proverbs 3:29.
